titulo: NASA’s Chandra Breaks Down ‘Treble Clef’s’ Galaxy Cluster Collision
cuerpo: Astronomers have used NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory to break down the cause of a remarkable formation of radio waves they have nicknamed the “Treble Clef” because its distinct shape strongly resembles the musical symbol.
